text: Mark, can I ask you something? When did you leave the operating room?
In 2015. I worked as a general surgeon for eleven years, and then I stopped.
And what have you done since then?
I have worked in hospital management. I have not operated since 2015.
I did at the beginning. For two years I thought about going back every single week.
Now, no. I have found a different way to be useful, and I have made my peace with it.
I graduated from medical school and then I trained in trauma surgery.
I worked in the operating room for years, and then I moved to the data side.
I have not operated since I made the change.
The turning point was the first project with real data.
So far this year I have started the course, but I have not taken the exam yet.

Good evening. My name is Ricardo Lemos, and I am an orthopedic surgeon. I graduated in 1998, and I did my training in Porto Alegre. In 2004 I moved to Rio, and I worked in the same hospital for fourteen years. Then, in 2018, I had a small accident and I could not operate for eight months. That was the turning point. During those eight months I studied statistics, and when I came back I asked for a different job. Since 2019 I have been the director of quality at the hospital. I have not operated since then, and honestly, I have not missed it as much as I expected.

Hello, this is the registration office. I am calling about the documents you sent last month. We received them on the fifteenth, and we opened your file the same week. There is one problem. The diploma you sent is a copy, and we have not been able to accept copies since January. The rule changed this year. Please bring the original document, or a certified version, before the end of next week. I am sorry for the extra work. We have had this problem with several candidates this month, and we are trying to make the rule clearer on the website.
